2609.30050.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
2609.30050.paper_summary: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.
2609.30050.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 NNV3，最新版本的神經網絡驗證 (NNV) 工具，這是一個用於深度學習模型和學習驅動的網絡物理系統的正式驗證的 MATLAB 框架。基於 NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) 和 NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs) 的集合基礎可達性，NNV3 引入了 Star-set 家族的新成員：ModelStar 用於在權重擾動下驗證網絡，VolumeStar 用於視頻和 3D 體積輸入，GraphStar 用於圖神經網絡。一種基於符合推斷的概率可達性模式補充了在確定性驗證無法處理的問題上的可靠分析，而 FairNNV 則認證了在連續輸入區域上的反事實和個體公平性屬性。NNV3 引入了新的基準，用於惡意軟件檢測、基於圖的電力系統模型、醫學影像、可變長度時間序列數據和動作識別。NNV3 還通過統一的文檔網站整合了教程和開發者指南。本文詳細介紹了這些重大更新，展示了 NNV 成為一個全面、穩健且易於訪問的驗證工具的成熟，適用於各種 AI 系統。
